hero.education: B.Sc. Student of Computer Science @ CIn/UFPE

projects.title: My Projects
projects.seeMore: See more of my projects at

items.homelab: Self-hosted GitOps platform running k3s on a single VPS, with declarative ArgoCD deployments and end-to-end observability.
items.chesskernel: Real-time multiplayer chess platform with live games, matchmaking and Stockfish-powered analysis.
items.pixelhub: Gather-style 2D virtual world where players move around a map and talk through proximity-based voice chat.
items.2048: My rendition of the classic single-player sliding tile puzzle game.
items.chess: The classic chess game, built from scratch in Python.
items.festalab: A user management dashboard with registration, editing, deletion, listing, pagination and search.
items.frogNinja: An engaging 2D platformer featuring a frog, packed with jumps, obstacles and surprises.
items.oncase: A web application for managing user data and presenting it through an interactive dashboard.
items.domino: A real-time multiplayer Domino game for two players, built with React and Flask-SocketIO.
items.palavrinha: A word-guessing game inspired by Wordle, designed for Portuguese speakers.
